title: Field Day

lesson.themeZh: 同理心、责任感，以及在竞赛中做出正确选择
learningObjectivesZh: 梳理三脚赛跑的路线、人物配合方式及比赛中的关键变化
理解Daisy和Grace如何通过稳定配合超过Parker和Tim
说明受伤小鸟如何改变比赛，并解释Daisy最后的选择

sections.title: Getting Ready for the Three-Legged Race
sections.summaryZh: Daisy和Grace练习三脚赛跑，逐渐找到配合的节奏。另一边，Parker指挥Tim行动；Grace指出Tim是班里跑得最快的学生。Daisy因此期待她们也许能赢过男生。

sections.title: The Race Turns Downhill
sections.summaryZh: 赛道从平坦的足球场转向下坡小路。Parker不听Tim的提醒，急着向前冲并绊了一跤；Daisy和Grace则保持稳定，按照练习时的节奏配合，追上并超过了男生。

sections.title: The Injured Bird Changes Everything
sections.titleZh: 受伤的小鸟改变了比赛
sections.summaryZh: Daisy听见小鸟求救，发现它似乎受了伤，于是叫停比赛。小鸟随后消失，Mr. Neal建议不要惊扰它；但Daisy不愿置之不理，决定即使错过比赛也要寻找它，最后趁没人注意时返回草地。

questions.question: What did Grace say about Tim while watching him practice with Parker?

options.text: He was the fastest runner in their class.
He was the best at choosing the race route.
He had never run with a partner before.
He had asked Parker to be his partner.

questions.explanation: Grace明确指出Tim是班里跑得最快的学生。她还说Parker是通过欺负Tim才让他做自己的搭档，并不是Tim主动选择了Parker。

questions.question: Why did Tim warn Parker to slow down during the race?

options.text: The soccer field was too crowded.
The race had already ended.
The downhill section would be harder to manage.
Daisy and Grace had already reached the finish line.

questions.explanation: Tim提醒Parker，下坡路段会更难跑，因此应该放慢速度。Parker却认为慢下来很软弱，仍然向前猛冲，结果绊倒了。

questions.question: What helped Daisy and Grace move ahead of Parker and Tim?

options.text: They changed partners halfway through the race.
They stayed steady and counted together as they had practiced.
They took a shortcut through the trees.
They stopped running while the boys argued.

questions.explanation: Daisy和Grace保持稳定，没有像Parker和Tim那样争吵。Daisy按照练习时的节奏数拍，两人配合默契，逐渐追上并超过了男生。

questions.question: Why did Daisy call for everyone to stop the race?

options.text: Parker had fallen and needed help.
Miss Chan had asked the teams to return to the classroom.
The teams had already reached the finish line.
She heard a bird cry for help and say its wing was broken.

questions.explanation: Daisy听到一个声音求救，并说自己的翅膀受伤了。她随后看见一只棕色小鸟，于是立即叫大家停下，避免继续比赛伤害或惊吓它。

questions.question: Why did Daisy secretly return to the meadow at the end?

options.text: She wanted to look for the frightened bird, even if she missed the race.
She wanted to avoid going back to class.
She had forgotten something beside the biggest tree.
She wanted to race Parker without the other teams.

questions.explanation: Daisy认为那只小鸟仍然可能躲在附近，而且听起来非常害怕。她告诉Grace，即使因此错过比赛也要去寻找小鸟，最后借口去洗手间，趁没人注意时返回草地。

reviewNotes: 依据 GitHub Actions Run 43398340832 取得的真实官方素材：31段英文Text、53条字幕时间轴；官方播放器标题 Daisy Dolittle, The Disappearing Bird 2: Field Day 与本集标题匹配，Storybook HEAD HTTP 200，官方M3U8已验证。按段落及字幕时间轴划分3个教学部分，覆盖赛前准备、比赛发展和受伤小鸟引发的结尾行动。12个词汇均能在本集英文原文定位，中文释义与例句为原创辅助内容。5道原创英文剧情理解题分别定位p6、p11–p13、p14–p16、p17–p20、p28–p31；逐题核对剧情事实、唯一答案、四个不重复选项及中文解析，覆盖开端、发展、突发冲突和结尾。未使用其他集或原著剧情；未向公开仓库写入全文、字幕全文或长篇逐字引用。
